ctx.x: Well, no, we didn't -- actually we didn't have any transportation at this time of night, you know. So we were just stuck up here, but it was just gorgeous country, beautiful country. A lot of poverty. But musically it was very good because as you know Billy Taylor was a superb pianist, and Bud and Kenny Durham. Well, it was just a good band. And that was another time that I worked with the great

Budd Johnson. We toured together again in Europe in later years. He was with Quincy's band, Quincy Jones' band. And Bud was very unhappy, he hadn't been home for quite a while. And actually Quincy stayed over there about two years. But that was a great band. They played for us, Nat Cole, and speaking of an all star band, Jerome Richardson, Shahab, Bud Johnson, Phil Woods, Lennie Johnson, it was just an exciting exciting band. It was a thrill to have them to travel with us.
